name: Fall Down Fast
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Observe the character or object positioned on the high platform.
Find the trigger mechanism, support rope, or button to release them.
Tap quickly to drop the target down toward the goal zone.
Avoid any mid-air traps or barriers blocking the vertical descent.
Land safely at the bottom to win the level.
